findings.description: purchase event is missing required transaction_id and sends value as a string ('49.99') instead of a number, so revenue/conversion is silently dropped or mis-attributed.
findings.expected_fix: Add transaction_id at checkout and coerce value to a number before send; add a schema check (structured-output-validator style) on the purchase payload.

findings.description: Hard-coded (fake demo) API key committed to source and duplicated as a plain-text GTM container variable.
findings.expected_fix: Revoke/rotate the key, read it from env/secret storage, remove it from the container variable, and gate future commits with pre-commit-secret-guard.

findings.description: Tool call has no args snapshot and its output embeds a now() wall-clock value, so trace replay cannot reproduce it.
findings.expected_fix: Require an args snapshot on every call and inject the clock as an explicit recorded input, so tool-call-trace-replay can re-run the call deterministically.

findings.description: Tool output returns a customer's (invented) email and phone in plain text; storing or displaying the raw trace leaks PII.
findings.expected_fix: Run tool-output-pii-redactor on every tool output before the trace is stored or shown; keep the raw value only in the source system.

pass_bar: Cockpit catches >=3 of 4 faults, proposes the expected fix direction for each, and applies nothing without the approval gate.
